name: Text Shimmer
description: Text with a soft light sheen sweeping across it left to right, perfect for announcement pills, badges and subtle loading labels.
usage: Import TextShimmer and wrap any short string, e.g. <TextShimmer>Now in beta</TextShimmer> inside a pill, or set as="label" with a longer duration for a subtle loading label. Tune duration, spread, baseColor and shineColor via props.
